question: List each pair of singers who performed together in at least one concert. Do not include a singer paired with themselves.
incorrect_sql:

    s1.Singer_ID AS singer_1_id,
    s1.Name AS singer_1_name,
    s2.Singer_ID AS singer_2_id,
    s2.Name AS singer_2_name
FROM singer_in_concert AS sc1
JOIN singer_in_concert AS sc2
    ON sc1.concert_ID = sc2.concert_ID
JOIN singer AS s1
    ON TRY_CAST(sc1.Singer_ID AS BIGINT) = s1.Singer_ID
JOIN singer AS s2
    ON TRY_CAST(sc2.Singer_ID AS BIGINT) = s2.Singer_ID
